people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
translations.bsb: for on account of Abraham’s wife Sarah, the LORD had completely closed all the wombs in Abimelech’s household.
translations.kjv: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
translations.asv: For Jehovah had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.
